name: comp-171
title: Interactive Star Rating
description: Five large stars under the line Rate your experience, grey at rest, that preview a score on hover and keep it once clicked. The star under the cursor swells slightly as it lights.
use: Collecting a one to five score where a hover preview helps people land on the right star count.
avoid: No number or word shows the current score, so half stars and a neutral no-score state are impossible.
a11y: Each star carries hidden text such as 3 stars and the group shows a focus ring; the hover tint and scale have no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A big white heading sits above five five-pointed stars in a single row on black, all flat grey until chosen. The stars are widely spaced and all the same size; picked ones turn amber.
behaves: Hovering a star tints every star up to it amber and briefly enlarges just the hovered one; leaving clears the tint back to the saved score. Clicking locks the fill at that count, and the clip settles on two stars.
customise: The heading and the five star values are written in the file, as are the icon size, amber and grey colours and the scale step. A different star count means editing the array.
weight: light: Five SVG stars with a colour and scale transition; idle when untouched.
